# Boise Cascade

> Boise Cascade Company (NYSE: BCC) is a North American manufacturer of engineered wood products (I-joists, LVL beams and headers, glulam, mass timber), structural panels and lumber, and a wholesale distributor of building materials through its Building Materials Distribution (BMD) network. It publishes no public API, SDK or developer program; its software products are end-user applications for EWP dealers, distributors, specifiers and builders, and its only documented machine integration is an ANSI X12 EDI document exchange for BMD customers.

## Products

- [Engineered Wood Products](https://www.bc.com/ewp/): AJS and BCI I-joists, Versa-Lam LVL, Versa-Stud, rimboard, BOISE GLULAM, mass timber
- [Building Materials Distribution](https://www.bc.com/distribution/): Wholesale distribution of building materials to dealers, home centers and industrial customers
- [Wood Product Resources](https://www.bc.com/wood-product-resources/): Resource library — literature, evaluation reports and installation guides

## Software (end-user applications, no public API)

- [Software overview](https://www.bc.com/ewp/software/): The Boise Cascade software suite for EWP dealers, distributors, specifiers and builders
- [BC Calc](https://www.bc.com/ewp/software/bc-calc/): Free single-member sizing and engineering analysis software for design professionals
- [BC Connect](https://www.bc.com/ewp/software/bc-connect/): Web-based project and operations workflow software for EWP dealers and distributors (hosted at www.bcconnect.com; login required)
- [BC Framer](https://www.bc.com/ewp/software/bc-framer/): Professional 3D floor and roof framing design and analysis
- [BC FastPlan](https://www.bc.com/ewp/software/bc-fastplan/): Simplified 3D design and analysis
- [BC FloorValue](https://www.bc.com/ewp/software/bc-floorvalue/): Floor system performance analysis
- [BC Estimator](https://www.bc.com/ewp/software/bc-estimator/): EWP estimating software
- [Software support](https://www.bc.com/ewp/support/): In-house training and support for the software suite
- [Software EULA](https://www.bc.com/software/eula/): End-user license agreement for the software suite

## Customer portals (login required)

- [BMD eCatalog](https://www.bc.com/bmd-ecatalog/): Online ordering for dealers and home centers — pricing, quotes, PO status, delivery schedule, invoices and proofs of delivery; the portal itself is at https://ecatalog.bc.com/ (redirects to login)
- [Wood Products Orders](https://www.bc.com/wood/): Order-status site for wood products customers at https://woodorders.bc.com (access through a Customer Service Representative)

## Integration

- [EDI for BMD customers](https://www.bc.com/portal/customers/): ANSI X12 EDI over VAN or FTP — receives 810, 820, 824, 850, 855, 856, 997; sends 810, 820, 846, 850, 852, 855, 856, 864, 870, 997. Onboarding through the BMD EDI Group (Billerica_EDI@BC.com)

## Not published

- No developer portal, API reference, OpenAPI/AsyncAPI/GraphQL contract, SDK, webhook, MCP server or A2A agent card on any Boise Cascade host (checked 2026-09-19: www.bc.com, ecatalog.bc.com, woodorders.bc.com, www.bcconnect.com, api.bcconnect.com, authentication.bcconnect.com). api.bcconnect.com is the private AWS API Gateway backend of BC Connect and answers 403 Forbidden to every path.
